Type B: Test Issue

Renamed Elements

Dashboard buttons were renamed in a UI update. The button previously called "Generate Report" is now "Create Report". An old test clicking "Generate Report" will not find the element.

Failure Scenario: element_renamed

The action buttons were renamed during a UI refresh. The functionality is identical, only the labels changed.

  • "Generate Report" was renamed to "Create Report"
  • "Show Analytics" was renamed to "View Analytics"
  • "Download Data" was renamed to "Export Data"
  • Old test behavior: Click the button labeled "Generate Report"
  • Expected fix: Click the button labeled "Create Report" instead
